title: Chain Review
tagline: Blockchain browser extension, incentivizing, rating and tracking peer reviews on arXiv
description:
This project is going to combine on chain data and browser-based frontend to allow users to deal with the pain points!

With chrome extension, Web3 concept and the classic site that researchers upload their papers (Arxiv), we can do things like comment, vote, raise incentive	reward, create on chain identity, build reputation among the Arxiv data!
how_its_made:
This project is a browser-based extension, we can generate some components and insert to the page so that users can connect to wallet, send transaction, leave a on chain comment or vote for good reviews in the community we built, all within the page they familiar with! 

For now we used vanilla Javascript to design the extension with Web3.js, Metamask, and due to the time and low network issue, we aren’t able to integrate the protocols we want like Lens protocol, Filecoin in time, so we did a workaround and tried to bring up the whole concept and roadmaps.
